entities.summary: Rhett Thomas Rakhshani is an American former professional ice hockey player. He was selected by the New York Islanders in the fourth round of the 2006 NHL Entry Draft. Rakhshani is of Iranian–German–Mexican–American descent. He announced his retirement on December 14, 2022, after his wife had been diagnosed with cancer.
